question: What does the hosted Gemma API cost per million tokens?

retrieved.text: Gemma comes in several open-weight sizes. E2B needs roughly 2.9 GB to load at Q4_0 quantization, E4B needs roughly 4.5 GB, and the 26B A4B mixture-of-experts model needs roughly 14.4 GB because all 26B weights must be loaded even though only about 4B are active per token.

My laptop has an AMD Ryzen 5 7520U CPU, 16 GB of RAM, and no dedicated GPU. Because there is no discrete VRAM, everything runs on the CPU, so I picked the smallest model that works: Gemma E2B served through Ollama.

answer: INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE: the sources do not state the cost per million tokens for the hosted Gemma API.
